skill.summary: Create a customized week-by-week 90-day plan to build credibility, form relationships, and deliver quick wins in a new job or role.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "New Job First 90 Days Plan" skill.
- Guides users through creating a structured onboarding plan for their first 90 days in a new role.
- Generates a customized week-by-week plan based on role, company size, industry, and start date.
- Includes stakeholder mapping, quick wins, 30/60/90 day check-in templates, and personal reflection prompts.
- Adapts recommendations to different company cultures.
- Designed to keep the plan actionable and user-friendly.
